5. Energy and actual thermal state

The nominal dedicated-module duty ledger is:

Purchased duty per attempt	Energy
Cam driver	150 J
Proof and unload actuators	140 J
Controller and observations	342 J
Camera and lighting	32 J
Brush/local vacuum	20 J
Supply startup and standby allowance	30 J
Total	714 J

At 2% rejection, this is 729 J per accepted service. Extending restoration observation to 120 s raises it to approximately 912 J/accepted. Twenty additional wholly rejected challenges per 500 accepted cycles give approximately 757 J/accepted under the nominal duty.

These remain common-meter test targets.
